newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia building approvals trend up 1.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia building approvals trend up 1.1 pct.

text.p: Australian building approvals are rising at a consistent trend rate of around one percent a month, with approvals of private-sector buildings accelerating, Australian Bureau of Statistics figures show.
The trend rise for total approval numbers in December was 1.1 percent, following rises of 1.1 or 1.0 percent in the three previous months, the figures showed.
Private-sector approvals rose at a trend rate of 1.3 percent in December, having accelerated from 0.5 percent in August.
Non-residential approvals are still tending to grow very strongly but at a moderating rate.
The trend value of non-residential construction rose 2.1 percent in the month. The rate has fallen from a peak rise of 5.4 percent in August.
Public sector approvals are trending down. Their number fell 2.0 percent in trend terms in December.
